MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "None of these items felt like a natural next purchase for me right now.",
    "The threaded inserts had some connection to my recent nails, screws and anchors, but that connection alone did not establish a need for them."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "My purchases of nails, wood screws and drywall anchors do not imply that I currently need metal-cutting wheels, electronics cleaner or precision measuring tools.",
    "Threaded inserts require a matching bolt and application, and battery terminals require a specific cable setup; I have not shown a need for either.",
    "Epoxy and glue do not serve the same purpose as the mechanical fasteners I have been choosing, and a ten-pack of glue would exceed my current needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat general workshop usefulness as enough reason for me to buy something now.",
    "They extend my interest in fastening supplies to unrelated repair, wiring and measurement tasks without a clear connection to my purchases."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The dimensions, materials and compatibility details in my fastening purchases matter more than a broad association with tools or repairs.",
    "My vacuum-bag purchase points to a specific replacement need, not a general interest in maintenance supplies.",
    "I need a concrete use for an item before choosing it; being potentially handy is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized a broad practical-supplies interest but missed the specific applications and compatibility that make an item useful to me now."
}
